title: Monocypher ChaCha20 stream cipher
summary: crypto_chacha20 whole-block loop from Monocypher: 16 blocks (1 KiB), each one chacha20_rounds (20 rounds of add/xor/rotate quarter-rounds), add input state, xor plaintext.
reference_note: Base RV32IM has no rotate; the bit-manipulation extension Zbb adds rol/ror, and Zbkb adds crypto-oriented bit ops.
